candidate.title: ReAct Prompting
candidate.description:
ReAct (Reasoning + Action) prompting enhances a language model’s problem-solving by enabling it to not only think through complex tasks but also take actions and refine its approach based on observations. This video covers the fundamentals of incorporating ReAct principles into your prompts.

📝 Check out our guide to prompt optimization here: https://arize.com/blog/prompt-optimization-few-shot-prompting/

Resources:
